kbmi.loc: PDF p. 1, Ukuran Utama (Key Metrics) - Bank secara Individual, row 2 'Modal Inti (Tier 1)' 15,913,970 (Rp juta) at 30-Sep-26
kbmi.note: KBMI 3 = core capital above Rp14tn up to Rp70tn (POJK 12/POJK.03/2021); derived from the Tier 1 figure, no Mayapada document states its KBMI class. Tier 1 crossed Rp14tn in Q1 2026 (31-Mar-26 15,334,534; 31-Dec-25 13,290,624 = KBMI 2 band, also AR2025 PDF p. 105 'Modal Inti (Tier I) 13,291' Rp bn) after OJK approved a Rp2.0tn shareholder capital deposit as paid-in capital in March 2026 (LKTT Jun-2026 Note 27). Reviewer: check whether OJK has re-classified the bank; at FY2025 it was in the KBMI 2 band.

validation_ack.reason: Real: reported FY2021 basic EPS 3.99 uses the weighted average of 11,065,251,983 shares (FS2021 PDF p. 118) because the 4,999,958,150 PUT XIII rights shares were issued in March 2021 (ex-date 9 Mar 2021); 3.99 x 11,065,251,983 = Rp44.15bn = net profit Rp44.127bn. Year-end shares 11,832,368,850 give the 7% gap. Source: https://www.bankmayapada.com/images/Files/LapBerkalaSemester/LKT%20Bank%20Mayapada%20per%2031%20Des%202021.pdf

research_notes: No subsidiaries: Mayapada files stand-alone statements only (the IR page also posts "Laporan Keuangan Entitas Induk" copies of the same entity). Money figures carry basis "consolidated" per the schema; ratios come from the OJK published report ("Bank secara Individual") and carry basis "bank_only". Bank-only and group figures are identical.

No cash dividend was paid out of FY2020-FY2025 profit: every AGMS (21 Jul 2021, 29 Jun 2022, 24 May 2023, 28 Jun 2024, 30 Jun 2025, 30 Jun 2026) put Rp1.0-1.5bn into the statutory reserve and retained the rest. Hence no dividend records; payout_ratio v 0 with the AGMS result as source. The IR page "Dividen" tab is empty.

PMHMETD XIV accounting: the 14,335,488,880 rights shares were issued on 24 Jan 2024 and listed, but the FY2024 and FY2025 balance sheets keep issued capital at 11,832,368,850 shares (Rp1,338,539 juta) and carry the proceeds (net Rp2,144,516 juta) as "Uang muka setoran modal" pending OJK administrative approval (FS2025 Note 29, PDF pp. 93-94). The FS2024 EPS (2.16, AR2024 likewise) used 11.83bn shares; the FS2025 re-presents FY2024 EPS as 0.98 on 26,167,857,730 shares. shares_out FY2024/FY2025 = 26,167,857,730 and FY2024 eps = 0.98 (re-presented). By 30 Jun 2026 the register and paid-in capital show 26,167,857,730 shares / Rp2,772,088 juta.

1% of the issued shares (261,678,577 at 2026; 118,323,688 before 2024) are held unlisted by PT Mayapada Karunia under PP 29/1999 (FS Note 1b). The AR share tables print only the listed 99% as "Jumlah Saham Beredar" (11,714,045,161; 25,906,179,152; 6,764,086,593); shares_out uses the full issued count, which is also the EPS denominator.

Year-end prices: the AR share tables print Opening equal to Closing in every quarter (a presentation quirk) and very thin volume (several quarters 0 thousand shares, e.g. 2020 Q4). The closing column is used as printed. With so little trading the AR close may differ from the price source; check the price_year_end cross-checks once prices/MAYA.json exists.

Rights issues 2019-2024 (all PMHMETD/PUT, no splits, reverse splits or bonus issues; AR2025 PDF p. 60 confirms no share-count action in 2025, and the 2026 AGMS/EGMS agendas contain none): PUT XII ex 2 Dec 2019 (14:1 at Rp2,200), PUT XIII ex 9 Mar 2021 (5,000:3,659 at Rp400), PMHMETD XIV ex 10 Jan 2024 (100:226 at Rp150, 53.6% taken up). fy.2019.year_end_price (Rp9,100) is stored for the price fetcher; there is no AR close before the 2 Dec 2019 ex-date in this file, so the price series can only be verified from that date.

LDR 2022 conflict: the OJK published reports print 82.13% (Dec-2022 report and Dec-2023 comparative); AR2022-AR2025 print LDR 2022 = 79.65%, which is the CIR value in the published report. Stored 82.13%. Gross loans / deposits = 82.3% supports it. CIR 2022 (79.65%) is stored as printed and marked doubtful.

Ratios outside the validator's plausibility bounds that are REAL: CIR FY2021 235.50% (NIM 0.69%; operating income propped up by a Rp991bn impairment reversal) and LAR FY2020 60.85% (Board of Commissioners report).
